title: Week 23: Dify

Week 23: Dify

LLMs

Last year, I was using a AI tool called Flowise. This time, I will talk about Dify, Dify can do almost everything Flowise can do. But the UI is more user-friendly.

After last week, I started to widely use commercial LLMs. I think it is important for me to understand how to use them. So, tools like flowise, Dify and n8n even langchain are important for me. Next week I will focus on using them.

Unity Unit Testing

Unity provides a good unit testing tool, but there are some flaws when using them. I've mentioned in Unity Test Framework.
